title: Ending a TRICARE Premium-Based Plan: Termination, Credits and Refunds
content:
These are the terms on which a plan under the **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans** ends at the purchaser's request and on which premium is credited and refunded.

**1. Ending the plan.** ~~A purchaser may end the plan at any time, but only by their own confirmation: the agent records the request as an intake and the purchaser confirms it.~~ This clause is no longer in force in this form for a TRICARE Reserve Select or a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan, where the current basis restates it in its own terms; for every other plan it continues to apply.

**2. Effective date.** Termination takes effect under the tier's termination-effective rule - on the later of the date the purchaser asks for and the date the request is made, never retroactively - and starts no lockout.

**3. Credit of premium paid ahead.** ~~Premium paid for days after the termination date is credited back: the month containing the termination date is credited for the days after the termination date at the monthly premium times those days over the days in the month, every later paid month in full.~~ This clause is no longer in force for the monthly bill of the most recently paid month of a TRICARE Reserve Select or TRICARE Retired Reserve plan whose purchaser came under active duty TRICARE coverage in that month, nor for the bills of the closing period of a TRICARE Reserve Select or TRICARE Retired Reserve plan ended at the purchaser's confirmed request; there it has been superseded by the current basis. Every other paid month, an ending for loss of eligibility or the purchaser's death, and every plan of another kind keep it. (The days in the month it referred to are the number of calendar days in the month containing the termination date.)

**4. Bills a credit may be posted against.** ~~A credit is posted only against a bill that has a payment posted against it.~~ This clause is no longer in force for a family-adjustment relief, a later-month family relief, a recall adjustment relief, a recall month relief, a Reserve Select closing reconciliation and a Retired Reserve closing reconciliation, which the current basis lets post against a bill with no payment standing against it; every other credit on the plan still needs a payment posted against its bill.

**5. Refund.** A credit balance is refunded through the original payment method within the tier's refund-issue days.

**6. Other terminations.** A termination for loss of eligibility or the purchaser's death is credited the same way.

## Clause 2 worked (hypothetical)

| Request made | Date asked for | Termination takes effect |
|---|---|---|
| 14 August | 31 August | 31 August |
| 14 August | 1 August | 14 August |

A termination under clause 2 starts no lockout, so it does not bar a later purchase.

superseded_clauses: A purchaser may end the plan at any time, but only by their own confirmation: the agent records the request as an intake and the purchaser confirms it.

Premium paid for days after the termination date is credited back: the month containing the termination date is credited for the days after the termination date at monthly_premium times those days over the days in the month, every later paid month in full.
A credit is posted only against a bill that has a payment posted against it.
